description: A café terrace on a cobbled square on a sunny day. A young woman in a yellow cardigan and black skirt sits at a table with a long white tablecloth, holding up a round white lid in one hand and looking down with narrowed eyes towards the ground. The young man opposite her in a white polo shirt sips from a coffee cup with wide, nervous eyes. Under the table a puddle of water spreads on the cobbles, right beside a white French bulldog sitting on the ground. A waiter walks past behind them.
